messages:
bryan: noticed a parity gap between mobile and server sampleapps: mobile SDK autoinit doesn't register the redact log processor so debug logs from the iOS quickstart show emails and request headers. anyone else see mobile-specific leaks?
kai: yes, hit that yesterday. mobile autoinit path is separate and currently only wires tracing & metrics; log processors were forgotten. paste a line?
bryan: example from my iPhone simulator run: `2026-11-02T10:11:12.001Z DEBUG req_id=mob-77 http.header.authorization=Bearer%20eyJhb... user.email=mobile.dev@realco.com event=signup_attempt`
megan: ouch. two problems: (1) auth header captured in structured attrs, (2) request id key (`req_id`) differs from server `rd.request_id` so cross-service traces are harder to correlate.
kai: root cause: mobile SDK autoinit uses a lightweight bootstrap to avoid pulling large deps. we intentionally deferred log processors for binary size reasons but that left a redaction gap. also mobile uses legacy `req_id` to be backwards compatible with older mobile releases.
bryan: repro steps I used: 1) clone mobile-samples 2) open ios/Quickstart in simulator 3) set env in .xcconfig: LOG_LEVEL=debug AUTOINIT=true 4) trigger signup flow and tail the device logs via `xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --predicate 'process == "sampleapp"'` and grep `@realco.com`.
nora: quick mitigations: - change mobile quickstart default to LOG_LEVEL=info - scrub sample emails to `example.invalid` - ship a small `post_install` script for iOS simulator that replaces sample creds with placeholders
megan: tactical SDK fixes: 1) make mobile autoinit register a tiny platform-friendly redact processor that strips common PII patterns and masks `Authorization` headers (implemented as a no-dep string-scan) 2) add a compatibility shim so mobile sets `rd.request_id` (canonical) in addition to `req_id` to aid correlation 3) document how to opt out of autoinit in mobile quickstart.
kai: implementation notes: mobile processors must be <10KB and avoid regex heavy libs. a simple byte-scan and replace for `@` sequences + masking of `Bearer ` prefix is enough in dev mode. we'll gate it behind `AUTOINIT_PII_GUARD=true` to avoid surprises.
bryan: test idea: add a simulator CI job that starts the iOS sampleapp, triggers signup, captures logs and fails if any `@` email or `Authorization: Bearer` appears. lightweight e2e smoke.
telemetry-bot: Created ticket INF-4100: "mobile quickstart: missing autoinit redaction -> PII and auth headers in debug logs" https://tracker.internal/INF-4100 :bug:
megan: longer term: SDK should document canonical attribute keys and include a migration table for older clients. also recommend proxies forward `x-rd-request-id` and SDKs prefer `rd.request_id`. add migration lint in our server-side ingestion to accept both keys for a transition period.
kai: i'll prototype the mobile redact processor and the dual-write `rd.request_id` shim. will aim to keep the processor zero-dependency and opt-in by default for quickstarts.
bryan: i'll open the PR to set quickstart defaults (LOG_LEVEL=info, seeds -> example.invalid) and add the CI simulator grep. assign to me for the quick changes.
megan: i'll update the SDK docs with the canonical ids and include code samples for mobile and server showing how to register the redact processor manually if teams want fine-grained control.
telemetry-bot: INF-4100 assigned to kai for SDK changes and bryan for quickstart updates. priority=medium.
nora: thanks folks. this should close a surprising surface for PII leaks in device demos. :white_check_mark:
